topic: Eustass Kid's metal box at Onigashima split Big Mom from her homies so Law could finish her; a side mechanic, not the pride thesis of the long
title: Eustass Kid's Metal Box Split Big Mom From Her Homies
description: Most people remember Law's boulder that knocked Big Mom off Onigashima. The setup that made it possible was Eustass Kid's metal box, which trapped her homie Zeus. Here is the chapter-cited sequence and why it was Kid's cleverest move in the raid.
comment: Was the metal box or Law's boulder the bigger reason Big Mom fell? Pick one.

lines.text: Eustass Kid built the metal box that pulled Big Mom's strongest homie away from her.

shot.search: Eustass Kid metal box Onigashima Big Mom
shot.fallback: pirate with metal arm building a steel box on a rooftop, anime style

lines.text: Her homies made her nearly impossible to beat.

shot.search: Charlotte Linlin homies Zeus Prometheus Napoleon
shot.fallback: Big Mom surrounded by her giant homies in the sky, anime style

lines.text: Kid and the other Supernovas agreed they had to split Big Mom from her homies, or they had no chance.

shot.search: Eustass Kid Supernovas Onigashima rooftop fight
shot.fallback: rival pirates standing together on a burning rooftop, anime style

lines.text: Zoro handled Prometheus, and Napoleon was knocked out of her hand.

shot.fallback: swordsman facing a glowing homie in the sky, anime style

lines.text: Then Kid formed a metal box, and Law teleported Zeus straight inside it.

shot.search: Eustass Kid metal box Trafalgar Law Zeus
shot.fallback: steel box glowing with lightning, anime style

lines.text: With Zeus locked away, Big Mom was disarmed and suddenly exposed.

shot.search: Charlotte Linlin Big Mom exposed Onigashima
shot.fallback: Big Mom standing alone without her homies, anime style

lines.text: Kid grabbed her arm with his prosthetic and pushed her up into the sky.

shot.search: Eustass Kid prosthetic arm grabs Big Mom
shot.fallback: metal arm gripping an emperor's arm mid-air, anime style

lines.text: That's when Law hit her with a boulder, and she fell off Onigashima.

shot.search: Trafalgar Law boulder Big Mom falls Onigashima
shot.fallback: huge boulder striking an emperor high above the sea, anime style

lines.text: Most fans remember the boulder, but they forget the box that set it up.

shot.fallback: steel box floating beside a rooftop, anime style

lines.text: My read: that box was the cleverest move Kid made in the entire raid.

shot.fallback: pirate captain grinning with a metal arm raised, anime style

lines.text: The box was the trick. What Kid's pride cost him came later.

shot.fallback: giant metal golem facing an emperor, anime style

lines.text: That box is why Big Mom's strongest homie was pulled away from her in the first place.

shot.fallback: steel box sealing a lightning cloud, anime style
